Language feature surface — parity census vs Go/Rust

Current-state census of what the .hexa language supports vs frontier languages (Go·Rust), captured 2026-06-27 by a 4-agent read-only sweep of compiler/ + self/ + stdlib/. This node is the SSOT index of language-level gaps (NOT a roadmap — actionable items live on the ING board;
history in CHANGELOG+git).

The framing premise: hexa is dynamically typed BY DEFAULT ({tag,payload} runtime values · generics erased at MIR), but a STATIC-TYPES MIGRATION is underway (Wall A: opt-in HEXA_STATIC_TYPES=1 REJECT ladder r1–r5 in main #4094→#4107 · r6 on feat/static-types-rust-r6 · Rust-target; plus const-generics+trait-bounds #4063 · type-alias #4064 · associated/higher-kinded-types branches).
`compiler/check/types.hexa` is a ~3.6k-LOC opt-in static checker (HX3011 let-mismatch et al.), no longer a stub.
Roughly half the 'missing' Rust/Go features flow from that single design choice, not from incompleteness.
Tier-1 — true gaps (BOTH Go and Rust have it, hexa does not)
Static generics / monomorphization — parsed only, codegen erases (`compiler/parse/parser.hexa:1811`). Limits codegen specialization.

OPT-IN slice R1 landed (PR#NN, `state/rfc_static_generics_monomorphization.md`): native `parse_fn_item` now consumes `<T>` (parity w/ struct + self/parser, byte-neutral), and a default-OFF MIR pass `compiler/optimize/monomorphize.hexa` (gated `HEXA_MONOMORPHIZE=1`, no-op unless a
`$$g`-marked template exists) clones+mangles a generic template per call-site concrete type (`id$int`/`id$str`) à la rustc/zig/swift specialization.
DEFAULT path stays erased + byteeq-neutral.

R2 COMPLETED end-to-end emit (PR#NN): `hir_to_mir::_lower_fn` now suffixes an `@specialize` fn's MFunc name with the `$$g` template marker under `HEXA_MONOMORPHIZE=1` (mirroring the `@gpu_*`→`gpu_kind` annotation precedent), so the pass actually emits `id$int`/`id$str` instances;

call-site concrete tag is captured from the const operand kind (no extra threading needed). The kept template is RENAMED to its base name as the erased fallback for `dyn` call sites (`$$g` never reaches codegen).
Asserted by `tool/test_monomorphize_emit.sh` (asm grep) + `self/test_monomorphize_emit.hexa` (runtime-neutral). DEFAULT (flag-unset) asm stays byte-identical on the 3 byteeq targets.
Type alias / newtype — LANDED (native path, `state/rfc_type_alias.md`): `type Name = Underlying` (+ `pub type`, generic `type Box<T> = …`, alias chains `type Temp = Celsius`) now parses.

No new keyword/token (frozen-parser safe) — `type` is detected as an `Ident` leader at item position via `compiler/parse/parser.hexa::_peek_is_type_kw`, mirroring the `extern fn` (`_peek_is_extern_kw`) idiom.

The alias is carried as an `ItemKind::Let` tagged `@phase("parse_only")` + a bare `__type_alias` marker (`compiler/parse/ast.hexa::item_is_type_alias`), so NO new `ItemKind` variant → every exhaustive `match ItemKind` site is untouched.

The types pass (`compiler/check/types.hexa::_types_register_aliases` → `_types_lower_type_ref`) builds an alias→underlying substitution table up front so `Celsius` lowers to `f64` everywhere a TypeRef is resolved (Rust `type Kilometers = i32` / Go alias semantics, bounded 16-hop chain
resolution defuses `type A = A` cycles);

`lower/ast_to_hir.hexa` drops the carrier so it emits nothing. Purely additive — alias-free programs are byte-identical on the 3 byteeq targets (the substitution table is empty → `_types_resolve_alias_name` returns its input unchanged).

Tests `compiler/parse/parser_test.hexa::case_type_alias` (alias_count=4, 0 diags, fn-signature use type-checks clean). R2 gap: true `newtype` nominal distinction (a distinct type that is NOT interchangeable with its base, e.g.
Rust tuple-struct `struct Meters(f64)`) — the current `type` is a transparent alias only.
Interface/trait dispatch — `impl T For X` PARSES (`self/parser.hexa:2603`) but no checking, no vtable. Method dispatch on structs works; trait-bounded polymorphism does not.
Operator overloading — fixed 21-operator set (`compiler/lex/tokens.hexa:58-73`), no magic methods.

OS threads / goroutines — single-threaded by DEFAULT (`stdlib/cancel.hexa:54`); async/await PARSE but run synchronously (RFC-022). The pthread spawn/join+condvar-channel runtime (`self/native/thread.c`) routes through `hxlcl_pthread_*` shims.

OPT-IN real OS threads LANDED: the shims are gated in `self/runtime_emit_full.hexa` — `#if defined(HEXA_THREADS)` maps them 1:1 onto POSIX `pthread_create`/`pthread_join`/mutex/cond; the `#else` branch is the byte-identical synchronous fallback (default).

`thread_spawn`/`thread_join` fn-globals become real OS threads under `-DHEXA_THREADS`; default preprocesses out → byteeq unaffected. hexa wrappers in `stdlib/thread_real.hexa`, oracle `self/test_real_spawn.hexa`. SSOT: state/rfc_real_concurrency_optin.md §c.

M:N green-thread integration DESIGNED (`state/rfc_mn_scheduler.md`): 1:1-spawn + async + work-stealing unified into Go GMP model; oracle `self/mn_scheduler.hexa` (29 assertions) + opt-in N=1 executor `HEXA_COROUTINE`; real `-DHEXA_MN_SCHED` C substrate = next pool slice; mid-fn yield = wall.
Real mutex/atomic — by-value sim is the byte-deterministic DEFAULT (`self/atomic_ops.hexa:1-3`).

OPT-IN real hardware atomics LANDED: C11/GCC `__atomic_*` seq-cst cells behind `#if defined(HEXA_THREADS)` (`self/native/thread_emit.hexa`→thread.c), hexa wrappers in `stdlib/atomic_real.hexa`. Default preprocesses out → byteeq unaffected. SSOT: state/rfc_real_concurrency_optin.md.
Regex — core + lookaround/backref LANDED (HYBRID engine). `stdlib/regex/thompson.hexa` = linear-time Thompson NFA (RE2-style, PR#4046, compile/match/search/find_all);

`stdlib/regex/backtrack.hexa` (R2) = bounded BACKTRACKING VM (Russ Cox regexp2) adding lookahead `(?=…)(?!…)`, lookbehind `(?<=…)(?<!…)`, and backreferences `\1..\9` — the constructs an NFA cannot express.

`regex_compile` auto-dispatches per pattern (Rust regex-style automata+backtrack hybrid; API unchanged); the backtrack path carries a step-cap (default 1e6, `regex_compile_capped`) that aborts catastrophic patterns SAFELY (`regex_last_error==1`).

**R4 (capture-span + variable-width lookbehind LANDED): `regex_compile_captures`/`regex_captures`/`regex_cap_count`/`regex_cap_span`/`regex_cap_text` extract per-group spans+text from the backtracker's `save` slots (group 0 = whole match;
PCRE `pcre_exec` ovector / Rust `regex::Captures` model — the capturing backtrack engine reports sub-groups, the linear Thompson engine reports group 0 only).

Lookbehind upgraded from FIXED-WIDTH-only to BOUNDED-WIDTH (PCRE2/.NET/Python-`regex`): a bounded-variable inner `(?<=ab?)`/`(?<=a{1,3})`/`(?<=foo|ba)` now compiles (scanned via a POS-EQ end-anchor over `[si-maxw, si-minw]`);
only UNBOUNDED `* + {n,}` still rejected.** Both engines byteeq-neutral (self/ does not import).

Package-manager dependency RESOLVER + registry — hx has lockfile/semver/ed25519 SCHEMA only (`stdlib/hx/lockfile.hexa`, `semver.hexa`); `hexa.toml [dependencies]` is empty, no transitive resolve, no central registry. The largest DX-canonical gap vs cargo/go-mod.
Tier-2 — Rust-only gaps (Go also lacks → lower priority)
Ownership / borrow checker — `own`/`borrow` tokens recognized (bootstrap.hexa) but NO checking; arena scope is the actual lifetime model.

RESEARCH RFC `state/rfc_advanced_typesystem.md` §4.1: borrow ENFORCEMENT is vacuous under the bump-arena (nothing frees mid-scope), but an advisory-only MIR dataflow lint (default-OFF `HEXA_BORROWCK=1`, warning `HX46xx`, reusing the already-recognized `move`/`borrow` tokens) is the
byteeq-safe on-ramp — reference: rustc MIR borrowck / NLL RFC 2094 / Polonius.
Strict enforcement is blocked on a non-arena allocator (`HEXA_STREAM_RECLAIM` free-tree).

Lifetimes `'a` — none (arena-scope owns lifetime, `self/codegen.hexa`). RESEARCH RFC `state/rfc_advanced_typesystem.md` §4.2: lifetimes are erased before codegen in rustc ⇒ byteeq-neutral by construction; the ONLY wall is the frozen lexer (`151c52c8`) cannot read `'a` syntax.
Honest ceiling = encode `outlives` relations inside annotation-arg strings (no new token/`@attr`), advisory-only.
Drop trait / RAII destructors — only `defer`/`drop` markers (codegen defer section), no auto-cleanup.
Associated types ·

HKT — none. RESEARCH RFC `state/rfc_advanced_typesystem.md` §4.3-4.4: associated types are gated behind trait resolution (Tier-1 gap, no slice) — RFC 0195 type-projection has nothing to resolve against; HKT is the deepest wall, needing a type system AND a kind system above it (GHC kinds;
Rust itself omits HKT, approximating via GATs RFC 1598/2289). Both are measured DESIGN-SCALE ceilings under the dynamic-erasure value model, not actionable slices.

Const generics + where-clause/trait-bound ENFORCEMENT — check-only OPT-IN reference slice landed (PR#NN, `state/rfc_const_generics_where_bounds.md`): the standalone generics typechecker prototype `self/test_generics_typecheck.hexa` models `struct Buf<const N>` (const param sentinel in the

bound slot — value-vs-type instantiation validation à la rustc min_const_generics) and where-clause desugaring (`<T,U> where T: Ord` ≡ `<T: Ord, U>`, multi-clause accumulation `T: Ord+Num`) with a rustc-faithful trait-impl registry (f64 is PartialOrd but NOT Ord — reproduced).

The check algorithm is now PORTED into `compiler/check/types.hexa` as the opt-in `_cg_*` pass (env `HEXA_CONST_GENERICS=1`, default-OFF, mirrors the proven `_exh_*` exhaustiveness gate): it decodes a synthetic `__cg` annotation off `Item.annotations`, validates const value-vs-type slots
(HX3007) and trait bounds (HX3008), and promotes bound violations from WARNING to fatal Error under `HEXA_STRICT_BOUNDS=1`.

Parser generic-param CAPTURE at `parser.hexa:1779/1868` serializes `<…>`+`where` into the `__cg` annotation only when the env is set (erase path verbatim otherwise → byte-identical AST). DEFAULT compile path untouched → byteeq-neutral; gen3≡gen4 fixpoint intact.
Pattern guards (`pattern if cond -> body`) — DONE (native path): parsed in `compiler/parse/parser.hexa::parse_match_expr` (reuses the `if` token, no new keyword;

stored as an If-kind `match_guard` carrier — `ast.hexa::ast_is_match_guard`, no new ExprKind variant), bound in `check/bind.hexa`, lowered through `lower/ast_to_hir.hexa` (HIR `match_guard`) → `lower/hir_to_mir.hexa` (guard `STMT_BR_COND`: truthy→body, falsy→next arm; Rust semantics).
Purely additive — unguarded arms byte-identical, so byteeq-neutral; self/ unused → fixpoint untouched. cite The Rust Reference §Match guards.
Exhaustiveness checking — non-exhaustive enum-match WARNING (HX3006, S3, non-fatal) in `check/types.hexa::_exh_*` (Maranget 2007 single-column enum usefulness;

guarded arms don't count toward coverage), opt-in `HEXA_EXHAUSTIVE=1` (default-OFF on introduction = zero diagnostic delta on the default build, release-integrity-first; promotable once corpus measured clean). Tests `self/test_match_guard.hexa` ·
`self/test_match_exhaustive.hexa`.
Struct-destructure patterns `Point{x,y}` — absent.

`?` error-propagation operator — DONE (both pipelines), opt-in `HEXA_TRY_OP` (default-OFF, byteeq-neutral). (a) self/ (gen2/interpreter): postfix `expr?` parsed in `self/parser.hexa::parse_postfix` (reuses the existing `Question` token, no new keyword; emits a `Try` AST node, distinct from the `try`/`catch` `TryCatch` node), now gated `p_try_op_enabled()`, and lowered in `self/codegen.hexa` (the `k == "Try"` arm, ~L5309) to a runtime success-tag discriminant — `HX_IS_ARRAY` && tag@0 in {`Ok`,`Some`} unwraps payload@1, else early-returns the receiver UNCHANGED via `_gen2_emit_tail_return_expr_raw` (identity re-wrap, no Rust `From::from`). (b) NATIVE (compiler/*) `--emit` pipeline (this work, r15-D2 r2): `Question` TokenKind APPENDED last in `compiler/lex/tokens.hexa` (no ordinal shift → fixpoint-safe); `?` scan in `compiler/lex/lexer.hexa` (gated, flag-off leaves `?` unlexable = today); `parse_postfix` builds an `ExprKind::UnOp` text="?" carrier in `compiler/parse/parser.hexa` (NOT `ExprKind::Try` = try/catch → zero enum edit, avoids the exhaustive `_hir_is_*`/`_expr_kind_tag` tables); `compiler/lower/ast_to_hir.hexa` re-tags the `?` UnOp to a distinct `HExpr.kind` string "tryop"; `compiler/lower/hir_to_mir.hexa` lowers "tryop" (gated, mirroring the `HEXA_MONOMORPHIZE` env-gate) to a map-backed enum success-tag discriminant — `field@"__tag"` ∈ {`hash(Ok)`,`hash(Some)`} → `field@"__p0"`, else STMT_RETURN the receiver UNCHANGED — emitting ONLY pre-existing MIR op shapes (field / `==` binop / BR_COND / BR / RETURN / copy), so NO codegen-backend (x86_64/arm64) change. CFG mirrors the match enum_path tag-test chain + the `&&`/`||` short-circuit join; expression-position `g(expr?)` hoists naturally. A single success discriminant unifies the Result(`Ok`/`Err`) and Option(`Some`/`None`) lanes (no compile-time lane split — dynamic-typed). Default-OFF everywhere → the `Question` token is never emitted and "tryop" never arises on a byteeq build, so gen3≡gen4 is untouched and shim.o/runtime bytes are invariant (`?` desugars into existing control-flow + enum ops, no new runtime symbol). Spec `docs/rfc/rfc_drafts/r15-d2-question-operator.md` (PROBE r15-D2). cite Rust `std::ops::Try` / RFC 0243 · RFC 1859, Swift `try?`. Tests `self/test_question_op.hexa` (run with `HEXA_TRY_OP=1`; 16/16, incl. F-D2-1..5 acceptance probes + T?/?. regression gates) + native-emit smoke `tool/test_question_op_emit.sh` (flag-off ≡ byte-identical asm + F-D2 cases under --emit).
Inline asm (`asm!`) — RFC + rungs 1-2 LANDED (`state/rfc_inline_asm.md`).
children.detail: The release-safe surface has two forms, both dispatched in native codegen like the existing `__hx_syscall0`/`__hx_syscall6` raw-instruction intrinsics (no new keyword, no new @attr — frozen parser 151c52c8 untouched; `@asm` already parses at `self/parser.hexa:332` but only emits a GCC C-fragment for cortex-M, not native bytes): rung 1 = per-opcode family `__hx_asm_<mnemonic>` (ships `__hx_asm_nop()`); rung 2 = the GENERALIZED passthrough `__hx_asm("<op>")` where the opcode is a COMPILE-TIME STRING LITERAL whitelisted to {nop, pause, fence} → per-target lowering (x86 nop/pause/mfence · arm64 nop/yield/`dmb ish`), gated behind opt-in `HEXA_INLINE_ASM` (default-OFF). Wired end-to-end across the syscall-precedent sites: bind whitelist (`compiler/check/bind.hexa`, `__hx_asm`), x86_64 emit (`compiler/codegen/x86_64_linux.hexa`) + encodings (`compiler/emit/elf_x86_64.hexa`: PAUSE=F3 90, MFENCE=0F AE F0), arm64 emit (`compiler/codegen/arm64_darwin.hexa`) + encodings (`compiler/emit/macho_arm64.hexa`: NOP=0xd503201f, YIELD=0xd503203f, DMB ish=0xd5033bbf, shared by the arm64-linux ELF backend), and the C-transpile mirror (`self/codegen.hexa`, target-conditional `__asm__ volatile`). ADD-only + env-gated — the compiler closure never calls `__hx_asm*` AND the default build leaves `HEXA_INLINE_ASM` unset, so DEFAULT emit is byte-identical and gen3≡gen4 holds (CI byteeq 3-target gated). stdlib registry contract (`asm_passthrough_intrinsic`/`asm_native_wired`) + interpreter test in `stdlib/firmware/asm.hexa`. reference-match: Rust `core::arch::asm!` literal-template rule, GCC `__asm__ volatile`, Zig `asm`. Ladder rung 3 = `rdtsc`/`mrs cntvct`; rung-4 WALL = true `asm!{"text"}` block (new parser block syntax → frozen-seed reflow + an in-tree mnemonic→bytes assembler, both forbidden under release-integrity today).

children.name: Function overloading — absent ('later def ignored', codegen comment).

Per-field struct visibility — parse + checker enforcement LANDED (was struct-level `pub` only). `self/parser.hexa::parse_struct_decl` already accepted an optional `pub`/`pub(scope)` on each field but DISCARDED it;
it now captures the visibility string onto a new `vis` AST slot (sibling of the proven `default_expr` slot — no new keyword/token, codegen ignores it → byteeq-neutral).

`self/type_checker.hexa` records per-field visibility in a `struct_all_field_vis[]` array parallel to the existing name/type registry and, in the `Field`-access arm, flags a `private` field reached from a non-`self` receiver.

OPT-IN via `HEXA_CHECK_FIELD_VIS` (default-OFF = zero diagnostic delta on every build path; `warn`/`1` → soft `[warn]`, `fatal`/`error` → hard type error), mirroring the `HEXA_EXHAUSTIVE` release-integrity-first precedent.

WALL (documented follow-up `state/rfc_field_visibility.md`): the module loader flattens all module sources before parse, so no per-decl module id survives to the AST — the enforced granularity is therefore the type's own methods (`self`-access), STRICTER than Rust module / Go package
privacy;
true cross-module scoping needs module-provenance threaded flatten→parse→check (design-scale). Reference: rustc privacy pass ·
Go unexported (lowercase) fields. Tests `self/test_field_visibility.hexa` (23/23 interpreter).
Present (anti-myth — these DO exist)

async/await syntax (synchronous exec), channels (POSIX FIFO + select), closures+capture, comptime blocks + const-fold, derive·macro parsing, `where`-clause parsing, variadic + default args, extern FFI, semver/lockfile/ed25519 signing.
Self-hosted toolchain entirely in .hexa: LSP (`self/lsp.hexa`), formatter (`self/formatter.hexa`), linter (`self/linter.hexa`), test runner — where Go/Rust ship these as external tools.
65 semantic attributes (`self/attrs/_registry.hexa`): @pure·@autograd·@quantize·@dispatch·@memoize·@watchdog·… richer than Go (comments) / on par with Rust attrs.
hexa-only (Go/Rust lack these — overtaking levers)
ATLAS theorem verification embedded in the compiler — `@cite(L[id])`/@verify gate, S8 fatal HX8004 refuses to emit a binary for an uncited formula-bearing fn.
Byte-identical self-host fixpoint (gen3≡gen4), default for --emit.
No-LLVM direct native emit (AST→IR→ELF64/Mach-O, linked by hexa_ld).
Arena deterministic memory (bump allocator, free=noop, GC-free).
Impact ranking (largest→smallest gap)
① Static typing/generics absence — root of half the Tier-1 list; but a DESIGN CHOICE (dynamic dispatch intended), not strictly a defect.
② Real concurrency + synchronization — single-thread + simulated mutex = zero multicore.

IN PROGRESS (opt-in default-OFF, byteeq-neutral): real `__atomic` atomics (slice-1) AND real OS-thread `spawn`/`join` now both landed behind `-DHEXA_THREADS` — `hxlcl_pthread_*` shims gated 1:1 onto POSIX pthread in `self/runtime_emit_full.hexa`, `#else` = byte-identical synchronous
fallback.
Default build never passes `-DHEXA_THREADS` (determinism isolation). state/rfc_real_concurrency_optin.md §c.

M:N scheduler (slice-③) DESIGNED + oracle landed (`state/rfc_mn_scheduler.md`, `self/mn_scheduler.hexa`): unify spawn/async/work-stealing into Go GMP; cooperative N=1 executor opt-in `HEXA_COROUTINE`; true-parallel C substrate `-DHEXA_MN_SCHED` = next pool slice.
③ hx dependency resolver — cargo/go-mod core, schema-only today; independent + low release-integrity risk + DX-canonical → best impact/effort.
④ regex (linear-time Thompson NFA core PR#4046 + R2 lookahead/lookbehind/backref via bounded backtracking VM `stdlib/regex/backtrack.hexa`, auto-dispatched, step-cap guarded;
R4 capture-span extraction `regex_captures`/`regex_cap_span`/`regex_cap_text` + bounded variable-width lookbehind LANDED) + match exhaustiveness — frequent in real use.
⑤ borrow/lifetime/HKT — Rust-only, Go also lacks → defer.
Design walls — measured ceilings (intentional · identity trade)

Wall A — Dynamic {tag,payload} value model (no compile-time types). The runtime dispatches on a value tag, so there is no compile-time type to prove against. This is the root of most frontier-language gaps;
for each, the CHECK layer lands opt-in but the static-dispatch / type-parameterization depth is a ceiling: (1) full static type inference (HM/Rust-style) — no compile-time type exists to infer;
(2) `dyn Trait` fat-pointer vtable — only runtime-tag dispatch is expressible (PR#4086, HEXA_TRAIT_DISPATCH — reverted #4572: broke hexat seed-converge, re-land pending);
(3) higher-kinded-type (HKT) type-constructor dispatch — only kind-arity CHECK lands (PR#4084, HEXA_HKT, HX3011), true HKT dispatch ceiling-documented inside the HX3011 explain itself;

(4) type-based function overloading — types unknown at compile time → arity-mangle / runtime-tag dispatch only (PR#4066 — reverted #4572: broke hexat seed-converge, re-land pending); (5) value-dependent const generics — check-only validation (PR#4063, HEXA_CONST_GENERICS);

(6) full ownership-typed borrow checker — advisory heuristic on move-semantics + mut-capture proxy only (PR#4088, HEXA_BORROW_CHECK, HX2007/HX2008); (7) lifetime-parameterized types — scope-outlives advisory only (PR#4089, HEXA_LIFETIME_CHECK). Each (2)-(7) ships its CHECK layer;
only the static-dispatch / type-parameterization depth is the wall.

Wall B — Frozen seed 151c52c8 parser (no new keyword / token / @attr). The bootstrap seed compiler must keep parsing the compiler source byte-faithfully, so a genuinely new lexer keyword or token would break the faithful build.

Consequence: real `own`/`borrow`/`&mut` tokens are unavailable (`&` lexes only as bitwise-and, measured in PR#4088); `dyn`/`impl Trait` have no `KwTrait`/`KwImpl` (PR#4086 routes via contextual bare-Ident detection); new `@<attr>` attribute keywords faithful-build-break.
Every new language surface must route through contextual-identifier detection + an env-gate (the `_peek_is_*_kw` idiom) — no genuinely new syntax token may be introduced.

Wall C — Single-thread + byteeq determinism (COMPILER self-host scope ONLY). The compiler itself cannot use real parallelism without breaking the gen3≡gen4 byte-identical self-host fixpoint; multi-thread atomic is a no-op under the single-thread default.

NOTE: user programs ESCAPE this wall — stdlib `thread_real` (pthread 1:1, PR#4050) + `atomic_real` (C11 seq-cst, PR#4043) under `-DHEXA_THREADS` give real OS threads + hardware atomics; the default `#else` branch is the byte-deterministic synchronous fallback.
The wall is compiler-self-host-scoped, NOT a language-level ban on user concurrency.
Wall D — No-LLVM (chosen tradeoff, NOT a capability ceiling). No LLVM-ecosystem passes / tooling are available.

But hexa's own codegen reaches kernel parity~beyond (forge own-GEMM = cuBLAS parity~win, CPU BLIS GEBP 62-79% roofline + epilogue fusion), so this is a deliberate architecture choice with measured parity, not a forced ceiling.

Honest classification — genuinely-blocked-tech with code-0 = 0. Every wall-A/B item ships its CHECK layer as an opt-in default-OFF byteeq-neutral slice; only the deep static-dispatch / type-parameterization remains, with the reason embedded in the diagnostic itself (e.g.
HX3011 kind-system explain). Wall C is escapable by user programs (thread_real/atomic_real); Wall D is a chosen tradeoff at measured parity.
The walls are the identity trade hexa pays for being dynamic + bit-deterministic + frozen-self-host — and frontier-language determinism/verify/domain-fusion levers are what it buys in return.
ROADMAP (decision 2026-06-27 ·

narrow A+B toward Rust standard, both AUTHORIZED): Wall A — build a gradual SOUND static-type layer targeting RUST-level guarantees (NOT Go's minimal bar): opt-in HEXA_STATIC_TYPES default-OFF, byteeq-neutral, runtime stays dynamic ({tag,payload} value model kept for self-host
simplicity), but ANNOTATED code is compile-REJECTED (not advisory-warned) à la rustc.

Verify gate (g5)
children.detail: `hexa verify` is the single canonical verification surface and the project's g5 gate:

children.name: **S6 equational `@verify`** (in-compiler): canonicalizes LHS/RHS (const-fold, associativity, commutativity), checks equality, then does a deterministic sample-eval counter-example search. Failures surface as `HX6001` (normalization mismatch) or `HX6002` (witness found).
**S8 citation** (in-compiler): every formula-bearing function must resolve its cited `L[id]` in `static_atlas()`, with kind match and tombstone check, else fatal `HX8004`/`HX1099`.
**`hexa atlas verify` / `reverify`** (tool-level): recomputes atlas F/P nodes and reports `MATCH`/`DRIFT`/`UNVERIFIABLE` against the recorded claim (ε tolerance);
a successful verify **auto-folds** the verified atom into the atlas (`embedded.gen.hexa`) — verify is ambient, not a separate `atlas register` ceremony.
CI runs the same gate (`.github/workflows/lint.yml`); `hx commit`/`hx push` re-run the lint gate and stamp a `raw-all-attest` trailer so every commit is attested against the SSOT.

**지속 QA (verify-done 상시화)** — g5 게이트 위에서 모든 fix·기능·측정을 measure → root-cause → build-verify → 머지 한 루프로 닫는 상시 검증 루프(거버넌스 SSOT = CLAUDE.md 작업규칙 `QA`). 코드젠/런타임 변경은 byteeq 3타깃 + config 전수(REF · DEVRESIDENT · DEVFEED) byte-eq 실측으로, 측정 주장은 reference-match(roofline % · cuBLAS ·

nsys 커널 귀속)로 정답지에 대조해 증명한다. QA 하네스: `tool/restore_frozen_seeds` + `tool/build_cuda_runtime`(GPU byte-eq 빌드) · `tool/decode_eager_baseline.cu`(nsys 시간 귀속) · `release.yml` finalize(byteeq 3타깃 all-green stable 게이트). 산출(verdict ·

측정)은 memory/CHANGELOG/state 박제, cross-repo 측정은 `ing add --to <repo>` relay. 빌드/측정 = aiden/summer/vast pool(mini=git/gh only). 또한 **native-canonical-default polarity 위반**(native 를 플래그 뒤로 숨기고 외부의존을 기본으로 둠 · `HEXA_NO_<vendor>` 로 native opt-in ·

activeGoal.title: self-host DONE 3-기준 완료까지 (user standing goal · 영구 함대)
activeGoal.definition: self-host is DONE only when the toolchain needs NONE of: ① no hexa_cc.c (the emitted hexa->C transpile fallback; build/run lowers every flow through native source->own-IR->native) · ② no runtime.c (the ~5.5k-LOC emitted-C runtime/libc-syscall substrate; ported to native .hexa/.s/own-emit) · ③ no clang / external C compiler to build OR use hexa (own object-emit backend + hexa_ld do the whole compile+link). File-∅ of hand-written C is NOT the line; eliminating all three ①②③ is.
activeGoal.driver: perpetual 3-lane fleet (selfhost-done-3axis-fleet) — lane1=①hexa_cc, lane2=②runtime_c, lane3=③clang-flip — fire-on-arrival until each crosses DONE. SSOT for per-axis status = convergence.records[] + this node.
